title: fix(ui): preserve dashboard side-panel selection on reload
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: reloading a dashboard with Side chat or Files selected switches the side panel back to Chat.

## User Impact

User impact: dashboard reloads retain the selected side tab when the saved layout already matches the effective dashboard view. Explicit dashboard presentation actions and changed shared defaults still reveal the requested view.

## Why This Change Was Made

Passive dashboard activation replayed the operation that opens Chat, overwriting the restored active tab in memory. The board now restores the saved arrangement when its presentation already matches. The existing presentation owner still handles intentional changes. The dashboard documentation now describes this reload behavior.

## Evidence

- The new regression failed before the fix: two owner cases reset the companion selection to conversation, and the browser flow deselected Side chat after reload.
- After the fix: **123 owner tests** and **8 browser tests** passed. Coverage includes Side chat reload with a visible response, legacy layouts, shared split/expanded defaults, Files selection, explicit expanded links, tool-driven presentation, and compact behavior.
- UI test typechecks, production UI typechecking, dead-code checks, targeted type-aware lint, stylelint, formatting, and applicable repository guards passed. Independent Codex review through P2 found no actionable findings.
- Real Chrome proof used a matched Gateway and UI from local integration build `8a5954f136acdb91cb2a76edb80ed661f0adeec7`, with all four changed files byte-identical to this PR. A live provider answered a synthetic file question in Side chat; a hard reload retained both the selected tab and the visible answer.
- Refreshed with a clean normal merge of main `76604d06e97ea6ec3f502042f8056ae60ae57119`, including the upstream registry-lifetime repair #151692. All four feature files remain byte-identical to the original reviewed head. On refreshed head `cff2de78921850799df00c308ce96b3dfbef742c`, **48 presentation-owner tests** and **2 Dashboard reload browser tests** passed. Fresh independent Codex review through P2 found no actionable findings. [Current exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35336989464) passed: **117 successful jobs**, 12 skipped. The previously failing catalog-worker and real-Gateway API-key jobs both passed; all PR checks are green. Current-head ClawSweeper review found no actionable defects.
- The preceding [CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35330910338) passed all 3 UI owner shards, all 13 mocked browser shards, and the type check. It failed in a catalog-worker publication test using a retired plugin handle and in the real-Gateway API-key reload after CLI key removal. The confirmed API-key registry-lifetime race is repaired upstream by #151692; fresh CI passed this integration. The PowerPoint case passed in that hosted run.
- Previous exact-head CI passed all **3 UI owner shards** and **13 mocked browser shards**. Two shared Mantis failures are repaired by #151632. The remaining real-Gateway PowerPoint case timed out at the first Send click with an empty draft. One focused replay on its exact synthetic-merge product source passed the original assertions, including attachment delivery and recovery, without changing timing or adding waits. The replay used a dedicated test profile, home-backed temporary storage, Node 24.20 instead of CI's 24.19, and the documented serial local E2E config. The original hosted draft loss remains unexplained; this is not a claimed flake fix.
- The older outbox timeout was followed by green browser shards after integrating the upstream global-session reconnect repair (#151567). No timeout or assertion was weakened.
- The live proof covers a page reload. A fresh answer was created after restarting the Gateway for the matched build; this change does not add Side chat persistence across Gateway restarts.

The broad changed-check command was intentionally stopped after confirming that its UI lane selected all 20 core test graphs. Its 15 completed guards were retained, and the three UI test graphs plus shared declarations and the remaining applicable checks passed separately. A complete broad changed-check run is not claimed.

The screenshots below show the original selected Side chat, the incorrect Chat selection after reload before the fix, and the retained Side chat after reload with the fix. All content is synthetic QA data.

![Before: reload incorrectly selects Chat instead of Side chat](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6df462ab-7909-44c8-853d-83d6baa7c87f)

![After: reload retains Side chat and its visible answer](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3620e3a5-9025-4e7c-a0a4-7d3b9e3fec0c)
